fact: The World Bank letter of amendment, countersigned by Somalia's Finance Minister on 2 October 2025, finances expansion of the Teacher Management Information System and its integration with the EMIS under project part 1.3.

The World Bank restructuring paper reports EMIS enhancement with integration of an enhanced Teacher Management Information System and an offline teacher attendance module, terms of reference approved and delivery planned for April 2026.
